name: Jinan Shengquan Group Share Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinan Shengquan Group Share Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of synthetic resins and composite materials, biomass chemical materials, and related products in China and internationally. The company offers biorefinery products, such as biomass methanol, precursors, hard carbon, cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin; new energy industry products, including LTO cells, modules, forklift power supply, and outdoor portable power supply; and electronic chemicals comprising electronic chemicals and electrical materials products.
